## Proposed control
What should be added to the framework?

## Section it belongs to
Which part of the framework? (e.g., data minimization, model risk, third-party sharing)

## Rationale
Why is this control needed? What risk or gap does it address?

## Regulatory or standards mapping
Does this map to GDPR, CCPA, EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, etc.? Cite the specific article or clause if possible.

## Suggested wording
Draft the question or checklist item as you'd want it to appear.

## References
Links to papers, regulations, incidents, or prior art.
